items.q: like Tony Joseph’s parents that were in — these guys were like musical parents when I was in high school.

ctx.x: That was a really very interesting outlook and I appreciate your time today. I wish I could bottle some of that stuff you have.

I’m also trying to figure it out. Like I say, there’s a certain current, the way things are going on in the world, you don’t stand on a hill and say, “Wait a minute you’re all wrong.” There’s a momentum from the last twenty or thirty years going a certain way. You just try to do what you can instead of looking at something that is opposition or something, just going to see what you can make right. That’s just my idea of it, you know, based on all those older cats that were my mentors. There’s a beauty in the…
kids hate me, my dog bit me and I lost my job, but this concert man, you guys just made me feel so good.”
